scientific_integrity: The symbolic equilibrium and Hurwitz identities are derived in RESULT.md and recomputed by verify.py. Finite numerical eigenvalues are diagnostics only; general statements use exact algebraic proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic homogeneous SIS/opinion model restricted to zero infectivity of the second infectious class (alpha=0), equal susceptibility (delta=1), and a fixed susceptible-opinion ratio z in (0,1) with co-varying positive transmission and opinion-change parameters. The claim establishes local simplex-spectrum stability and transversal imaginary-pair crossings, not existence, direction, or stability of periodic orbits or global basins. Historical priority is literature-bounded and independent audit remains unperformed.
title: Reentrant spectral stability of an asymmetric endemic state in an opinion–SIS model
